native_operational_checks: Literal hostile argv remains data; no shell is inserted
Environment overrides validated and passed directly
Structured input, invocation, launch, timeout, combined output-limit, nonzero-exit and parser failures
Combined stdout/stderr bound retains exactly the configured byte maximum and prevents parser invocation on failure
Owned direct-child and descendant cleanup with inherited or closed pipes, on timeout and success
Capture bounds, finite positive rate, supported little-endian IQ datatypes and unique capability contracts
Gr-satellites full-file-only policy rejects sample ranges instead of silently decoding the whole recording
Gr-satellites telemetry submission explicitly disabled with GR_SATELLITES_SUBMIT_TLM=0
KISS payload/timestamp provenance retained with pending_downstream_validator and null transmitter attribution
Missing, oversized, FIFO and symlink KISS outputs rejected; explicitly empty KISS remains a successful zero-candidate result
scope_boundaries_and_explicit_hardening: The adapter itself is standalone Rust; gr-satellites remains a separately installed external comparison dependency and was not rewritten
Operational tests use isolated shell-script fixtures as external programs, never Python; adapters insert no shell themselves
Process containment uses Linux owned process groups and fails explicitly on unsupported platforms; this is not a malicious-program sandbox
Generic builder/parser closures are native Rust APIs; no legacy Python callback runtime remains
Candidate ordering matches frozen Python fixtures, including ASCII-escaped Unicode metadata sorting
Additional explicit limits: timeout at most 24 h, combined logs/KISS/candidate metadata at most 64 MiB, per-child-file output at most 1 GiB
Per-file RLIMIT_FSIZE additionally bounds child-created disk output; a large write can fail as nonzero_exit before KISS parsing
Relative SatYAML selectors are canonicalized so leading-dash filenames cannot become command-line options
Existing input identity hashing remains the campaign or manifest caller responsibility; external provenance does not invent a verified capture hash
Profile capabilities are declarations, not independently verified protocol support or transmitter attribution
No real gr-satellites performance or yield improvement is claimed by these adapter contract tests
